spec.description: Fleet capacity: CPU, memory, interface utilization/throughput, WAN uplinks (ifAlias ~ WAN). Companion to Device Summary — drill to Device Details.

spec.expr: topk(20, max by(device_name, if_interface_name, tags_snmp_group) (kentik_snmp_IfInUtilization{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}) or max by(device_name, if_interface_name, tags_snmp_group) (kentik_snmp_IfOutUtilization{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"}))

topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, tags_snmp_group) (kentik_snmp_ifHCInOctets{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, tags_snmp_group) (kentik_snmp_ifHCOutOctets{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 / 60))

sum by(device_name, if_Alias) (kentik_snmp_ifHCInOctets{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_Alias) (kentik_snmp_ifHCOutOctets{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60)

topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, if_Alias, tags_snmp_group) (kentik_snmp_ifHCInOctets{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60) + sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, if_Alias, tags_snmp_group) (kentik_snmp_ifHCOutOctets{tags_snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",provider=~"$provider",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"} * 8 / 60))

spec.title: 07. Network Capacity
